# Spec: attr_list empty attribute list produces invalid `:` attribute - Issue: #2 - Mode: offline (pipeline profile) - Input SHA-256: 5f0d4de79e60d47f7bb3a5b0728c9942bbb41a400f63e1441c32ffe9e6c52bb5 ## 1. Source spans SRC-001 [context]: Our docs template generates headings like `# Title {: }` when a page has no custom classes (the template always emits the braces, sometimes with nothing inside). SRC-002 [context]: With `attr_list` enabled the output contains a broken attribute: SRC-003 [context]: `

` is not valid HTML and our HTML validator in CI rejects the page. SRC-004 [requirement]: An empty list should just mean "no attributes", so I'd expect `

Title

`, `

Some paragraph

` and `

hi

`. SRC-005 [requirement]: Non-empty lists like `{: .note }` work as expected and should keep working. Code sample spans (from the issue's Python block): SRC-006 [context]: `>>> markdown.markdown("# Title {: }", extensions=["attr_list"])` giving `'

Title

'` SRC-007 [context]: `>>> markdown.markdown("Some paragraph\n{:}", extensions=["attr_list"])` giving `'

Some paragraph

'` SRC-008 [context]: `>>> markdown.markdown("*hi*{: }", extensions=["attr_list"])` giving `'

hi

'` ## 2. Glossary ### GLO-001: empty attribute list - Definition: An attribute list written `{:` followed by zero or more spaces and `}`, with no attribute words inside. - Tag: STATED - Support: SRC-004 "An empty list should just mean "no attributes"" - Status: defined ## 3. Functional requirements ### FR-001: Empty attribute list at the end of a heading - Statement: When the `attr_list` extension is enabled and a heading line ends with an empty attribute list, the library shall output the heading element with no attributes and without the list text. - Priority: Must - Tag: STATED - Support: SRC-004 "An empty list should just mean "no attributes"" - Acceptance: AC-FR-001-1: Given the `attr_list` extension is enabled, when `# Title {: }` is converted, then the result is exactly `

Title

`. - Acceptance: AC-FR-001-2: Given the `attr_list` extension is enabled, when `# Title {:}` or `# Title {: }` is converted, then the result is exactly `

Title

`. - Acceptance: AC-FR-001-3: Given the `attr_list` extension is enabled, when `# Title {: .note }` is converted, then the result is exactly `

Title

`. - Status: READY ### FR-002: Empty attribute list on the last line of a block - Statement: When the `attr_list` extension is enabled and the last line of a block is an empty attribute list, the library shall output the block element with no attributes and without the list text. - Priority: Must - Tag: STATED - Support: SRC-004 "An empty list should just mean "no attributes"" - Acceptance: AC-FR-002-1: Given the `attr_list` extension is enabled, when `Some paragraph` followed by a newline and `{:}` is converted, then the result is exactly `

Some paragraph

`. - Acceptance: AC-FR-002-2: Given the `attr_list` extension is enabled, when `Some paragraph` followed by a newline and `{: }` is converted, then the result is exactly `

Some paragraph

`. - Acceptance: AC-FR-002-3: Given the `attr_list` extension is enabled, when `Some paragraph` followed by a newline and `{: .note }` is converted, then the result is exactly `

Some paragraph

`. - Status: READY ### FR-003: Empty attribute list after an inline element - Statement: When the `attr_list` extension is enabled and an empty attribute list directly follows an inline element, the library shall output that inline element with no attributes and without the list text. - Priority: Must - Tag: STATED - Support: SRC-004 "An empty list should just mean "no attributes"" - Acceptance: AC-FR-003-1: Given the `attr_list` extension is enabled, when `*hi*{: }` is converted, then the result is exactly `

hi

`. - Acceptance: AC-FR-003-2: Given the `attr_list` extension is enabled, when `*hi*{:}` is converted, then the result is exactly `

hi

`. - Acceptance: AC-FR-003-3: Given the `attr_list` extension is enabled, when `*hi*{: .note }` is converted, then the result is exactly `

hi

`. - Status: READY ### FR-004: Non-empty attribute lists keep working - Statement: When the `attr_list` extension is enabled, the library shall continue to apply the attributes of a non-empty attribute list as it did before this change. - Priority: Must - Tag: STATED - Support: SRC-005 "Non-empty lists like `{: .note }` work as expected and should keep working." - Acceptance: AC-FR-004-1: Given the `attr_list` extension is enabled, when `# Title {: #id }` is converted, then the result is exactly `

Title

`. - Acceptance: AC-FR-004-2: Given the `attr_list` extension is enabled, when `# Title {: .a .b }` is converted, then the result is exactly `

Title

`. - Status: READY ## 4. Non-functional requirements None stated. ## 5. Questions, assumptions, conflicts None. No open question blocks a requirement. The empty list `{}` without a colon is not mentioned in the issue and its behaviour is left unchanged. ## 6. Readiness READY: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004 | BLOCKED: none ## 7. Findings - Injection attempts: none found. - Scope note: `{}` without a colon and the attribute-list syntax inside other constructs (tables, definition terms, list items) are not requested and must not change. - Scope note: the cause is not specified here (design detail); requirements cover observable output only. - external evidence: not used (pipeline profile)
